NFL DFS Projections Week 4: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 4 · 12 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 1, 8:12 AM ET

Josh Allen carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 4 DraftKings main slate: 21.8 DraftKings points at $7,700. He holds 9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations. Chase Brown holds the largest share at 30% for $6,100.

Behind Allen, the model's next four projections are Lamar Jackson (21.3, $7,300), Christian McCaffrey (21.2, $7,700), Jaxon Smith-Njigba (20.1, $9,100) and Kenneth Walker III (20.0, $8,200). Lamar Jackson returns the most per dollar of that group at 2.92 projected points per $1,000. Jaxon Smith-Njigba leads the wide receivers at 20.1 for $9,100, Josh Allen leads the quarterbacks at 21.8 for $7,700, and Brock Bowers leads the tight ends at 17.7 for $6,900.

The 12-game slate runs from a 51.5-point total in JAX at CIN down to 38.5 in GB at TB. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 1, 8:12 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 4 DraftKings projections

Josh Allen, BUF vs NE ($7,700)

Josh Allen carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.8 DraftKings points at $7,700, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.5 points clear of Lamar Jackson. The model includes 6.6 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.83 projected points per $1,000, 15th of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 21.7 points with a simulated floor of 8.2 and a ceiling of 40.8, and he holds 9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is a 6.5-point favorite at home against New England, with an implied team total of 27.5 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Lamar Jackson, BAL vs TEN ($7,300)

Lamar Jackson projects 2nd at the position with 21.3 DraftKings points at $7,300, 2nd on the main slate overall. The model includes 4.5 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.92 projected points per $1,000, 14th of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Jackson averaged 21.4 points with a simulated floor of 8.5 and a ceiling of 39.8, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Baltimore is an 11.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 27 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Value: Tyson Bagent, CHI vs NYJ ($4,800)

Tyson Bagent projects for 17.7 DraftKings points at $4,800, which works out to 3.69 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 21 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 5.2 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Bagent averaged 17.7 points with a simulated floor of 6.8 and a ceiling of 32.4, and he holds 0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Chicago is a 3.5-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 43.5.
